mission: We build the data and deployment infrastructure for physical AI. We collect footage of real work. The footage is precise and honest. We collect it fast and in large amounts.

values.s: Fix the problem where you are, right now. Do not wait for someone above you to fix it.
Be completely honest. Do not take shortcuts. Do not fake footage. Do not be lazy with the camera.
Feedback helps us improve. Anyone, at any level, says what they see.
If you do good work and take initiative, you can move up here. There is no limit.
Treat every phone, mount, and cap as if you paid for it.
You are fully responsible for your own area of work. You also help your teammates.
Be focused and disciplined in every task. Every 30-minute window of footage becomes part of the dataset.
